did: I built the Rust Rounds decay record. It works out what you know of each concept over the weeks from the weeks and essays home already keeps. It tells shown, met but not yet known, decayed, may have faded, not answered and not met yet apart, and it rechecks each concept on the Leitner system. The Monday routine now picks next week's topics from it first. The essay's chart and its role line, on the Dreyfus ladder, come from it too, instead of the stopgaps. Monday's first essay is unchanged, so it still renders on home as it is.

calls.title: Where the decay record lives
options: work it out from the weeks and essays home keeps
a new table and route on the server
a decay file in the mailbox each week
calls.why: Nothing new to store or keep in step: it can't drift from the essays it reads.
calls.undo: Add a server table of checks and have the routine read it instead (C267).

calls.title: When a concept comes back
options: the Leitner system, with relational as the pass
a fixed recheck every few weeks
calls.why: The story recommended Leitner, and it names its source as SOLO does. A concept known well waits longer each time, and one that slips comes back the next week.
calls.undo: Change the intervals or the pass level in the decay record (C268).

calls.title: The role line's ladder and rule
options: Dreyfus's stages, by the level half the concepts hold
Dreyfus's stages, by the median concept
calls.why: No public career framework grades Rust explanations. Dreyfus is published and was already on the sample. The rule reads at least three weeks, never one.
calls.undo: Change the rule or the stages in the decay record (C269).

calls.title: How the new chart reaches home
options: template version 2 only when the chart needs it
calls.why: Home's render image is rebuilt by hand, so an essay without decay or fading stays on version 1 and renders today.
calls.undo: Always write version 2, or drop the two cells (C270).

left: Rebuild home's render image before the first essay that draws decay or fading (template version 2), at least two weeks out; until then that essay waits.
A chart holds at most six concepts, which is what the recorded frame fits, so a week naming more loses rows from its own essay. The role line still reads all of them.
Two weeks that never get a final record from home would hold both of a Monday's essay slots forever; that's the Monday routine's oldest-first rule, not the decay record's.
